lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Melissa Ilardo's team published this in the journal *Cell* in 2018.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They also found a gene, PDE10A, that may make the spleen *bigger*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Scientists think it works through a body hormone, but nobody has *proved* that yet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The breath hold world record is twenty nine minutes, but only after breathing pure *oxygen*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Next time you slip under the water, your heart is already *slowing* down.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your body is still running a diving program far *older* than you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So could humans evolve to hold their breath like seals? Slowly, yes, and one people is already *on the way*.
